title: Getting Started with MongoDB - Database Manual - MongoDB Docs
content:
Getting Started with MongoDB

To get started and explore MongoDB, try the 5 minute interactive tutorial that connects you to a MongoDB Atlas cluster and walks you through inserting, querying, and deleting data in MongoDB.

Interactive Tutorial

You do not need to install anything. Click the Launch button of the in-browser Integrated Development Environment to start the tutorial.

After completing the tutorial, see Get Started to deploy a free cluster without any installation overhead.
